definitions.explanation: A secondary or supplementary title that appears alongside the main title of a book, article, film, or other work. Provides additional context or clarification for the main title. Not to be confused with movie subtitles ({字幕|じまく}).

examples.english: What is the subtitle of this book?

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副題|ふくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副題|ふくだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{表|あらわ}している→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: The film's subtitle captures its content well.

notes:
Refers to a secondary title of a work (such as the text after a colon in a book title), not to movie/TV subtitles displayed on screen. For on-screen subtitles, use ⟦{字幕|じまく}→字幕：04446_jimaku⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {副題|ふくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to add a subtitle
- 〜⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{副題|ふくだい}: a subtitle that says ~
- {副題|ふくだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: without a subtitle

FORMS:
⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ (secondary, vice-) + {題|だい} (title). The prefix ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧〜 appears in many words: {副社長|ふくしゃちょう} (vice president), ⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧ (side effect).

Similar term: サブタイトル (subtitle, loanword) is interchangeable in casual contexts.
